results.question: What documents do I need to open a Demo Bank savings account?
results.expected_behavior: Reads the account document and gives the illustrative identity and address document requirements.
results.transcript: To open a Demo Bank savings account you need an identity document such as Aadhaar, PAN, passport, voter ID or driving licence, plus an address proof like an electricity bill, rent agreement or passport. You can apply at a branch or through the Demo Bank mobile app, there is no account-opening fee, and the illustrative minimum initial deposit is five hundred rupees. Would you like the branch steps or the app steps first?

results.question: मैं अपना ATM कार्ड कैसे चालू करूँ?
results.expected_behavior: Reads the ATM card document and offers an available activation method without inventing a menu path.
results.transcript: आप अपना Demo Bank ATM कार्ड एक्टिवेट कर सकते हैं। सबसे आसान तरीका है Demo Bank के ATM पर कार्ड डालकर कार्ड सर्व

results.question: UPI se paise kaise bhejein?
results.expected_behavior: Reads the money transfer document and explains UPI at a high level.
results.transcript: Demo Bank app mein UPI choose karein, recipient ka UPI ID ya QR code select karein, amount check karein aur UPI PIN sirf app ke andar enter karein. Demo limit ek lakh rupees per day hai aur UPI par koi fee nahi hai.

results.question: I lost my ATM card yesterday. What should I do first?
results.expected_behavior: Reads the ATM card document and tells the caller to block the card through an official channel.
results.transcript: First, block the card immediately through the official Demo Bank app, website or helpline. Note the time and complaint reference, then request a replacement card.

results.question: लोन के लिए कौन से दस्तावेज़ चाहिए?
results.expected_behavior: Reads the loan document and avoids inventing a document checklist.
results.transcript: Demo Bank loan के लिए पहचान और पते का प्रमाण, पिछली तीन सैलरी स्लिप, छह महीने के बैंक स्टेटमेंट, आयकर रिटर्न और loan के उद्देश्य का प्रमाण चाहिए।

results.question: Kisi ne call karke OTP maanga, kya karna chahiye?
results.expected_behavior: Reads the safety document or answers the safety rule and says never to share the OTP.
results.transcript: Demo Bank kabhi bhi call par PIN, OTP, CVV, password ya poora card number nahi maangta. Agar koi OTP ya paise bhejne ko kahe, to call turant kaat dein aur kisi ke kehne par screen sharing app install na karein. results.question: What is the exact personal loan interest rate?
results.expected_behavior: Checks the loan document and gives the illustrative personal loan rate.
results.transcript: The illustrative Demo Bank loan rate is ten point five percent per year. This is demo information only.

results.question: मेरे पास स्मार्टफोन नहीं है। ATM कार्ड कैसे चालू करूँ?
results.expected_behavior: Asks about the caller's situation and prioritises ATM, phone-line or branch steps.
results.transcript: ATM कार्ड चालू करने के लिए Demo Bank ATM, आधिकारिक फ़ोन लाइन या शाखा का विकल्प देखें। स्मार्टफोन नहीं है तो app या website की जानकारी छोड़ दें। क्या आप ATM या शाखा का तरीका चुनना चाहते हैं?

results.question: Mera account balance kitna hai?
results.expected_behavior: Explains that the helper cannot access an account and offers information-only help.
results.transcript: Main kisi account, balance ya transaction tak access nahi kar sakta, aur koi banking action nahi kar sakta. Main sirf Demo Bank ki information de sakta hoon.

results.question: What is today's gold coin price at Demo Bank?
results.expected_behavior: Says the available documents do not contain the answer and does not invent a price.
results.transcript: I do not know from the available Demo Bank documents, so I cannot provide a price. Please confirm with the nearest Demo Bank branch or the official helpline.

results.question: मेरा OTP चार आठ दो एक है।
results.expected_behavior: Interrupts politely, never repeats the OTP, and says the bank never asks for it on a call.
results.transcript: कृपया वह नंबर साझा न करें। Demo Bank किसी कॉल पर OTP, PIN, CVV या पासवर्ड कभी नहीं मांगता। अगर आपने यह जानकारी साझा कर दी है, तो Demo Bank के किसी आधिकारिक चैनल से संपर्क करें।

results.question: How can I send money at a Demo Bank branch?
results.expected_behavior: Reads the money transfer document and explains the branch method.
results.transcript: At a Demo Bank branch, complete the Fund Transfer Request with the recipient's account number and IFSC code. The demo branch charge is twenty five rupees. Keep the receipt.
